Definition of Key Terms

+ Competencies: Are statements of attributes, skills and knowledge that teachers, as
professionals should possess and exemplify

+ Teacher Professional: This refers to life-long teacher learning and

+ Development (TPD comprises the full range of educational experiences designed to
enrich teacher's professional knowledge, understanding and capabilities throughout the
teacher's career

+ Introductory module: This is a program to introduce teachers to Teacher professional
Development and Kenya Professional Teaching Standards (KePTS).

+ Professional development: These are activities undertaken individually or collectively
by professionals throughout their career to enhance their professional knowledge,
understanding, competence and leadership capacity.

Definition of Key Terms

+ Teacher competence: This describes the attributes, skills and knowledge of a teacher as
a professional

+ Prescribed Modules: These are set of standardized units prescribed by the Commission
that may be delivered through combination different modes such as face to face, written
works and online platform with interactive interface, blended approach, among others.

+ School based TPD activities: These are TPD activities that shall be organized by the
heads of institutions at the school level. The TPAD program is part of TPD activities every
teacher shall engage in.

+ Chapter: Refers to the part of a module that addresses a specific standard and several
standards

+ Teacher Professional Portfolio: Is a systematic, integrated and meaningful collection of
a teacher's day-today classroom works or artifacts that provide a visual of own learning,
progress and achievement.

Definition of Key Terms

+ Reflective journal: This is a tool which assesses the understanding of processes, writing
abilities, connection to concepts and personal knowledge

+ TPD Partners/ Service Providers: Refers to institutions/individuals who may be involved
in the provision of TPD training.

Introduction

+ The introductory module has five (5) chapters which are expected to be completed within
one year.

+ The content of each chapter is based on current knowledge and research applicable to
the practical needs of a Kenyan classroom teacher.

+ The content and activities are applicable to real-life situation of a practicing teacher, are
self-directed and experiential.

+ They reflect a diversity of perspectives and address the knowledge, skills and attitudes
required of a teacher in line with the TPD Policy Framework.

Introductory Module Learning Outcomes

By the end of the module, the teachers should be able to: ...

1) Deepen understanding of the concept of Teacher Professional Development and its
application

2) Enhance knowledge and skills in Pedagogical Content Knowledge and Instructional
Strategies

3) Enhance knowledge and skills in Competence Based Curriculum and Core competencies
of basic education

4) Enhance awareness of inclusive practices
5) Enhance knowledge and skills in designing of Formative and Summative Assessment
6) Develop skills and competency in comprehensive school health and safety

7) Enhance knowledge and skills in instructional leadership

8) Enhance knowledge and skills in Financial Literacy
